title: Separate relative stiffness evidence from absolute health and missing construction action
statement: Under prescribed Delta, multiplying every comparator stiffness a,b,c,d,k by the same lambda>0 leaves its midpoint gaps unchanged while total stiffness scales by lambda. In the separate symmetric hardening example a=b=c=1 and lower repair force d*u+h*u^3, a neutral probe gives dstar=1-h*Delta^2/4 whenever this is a physical positive stiffness. Thus nonlinear response makes the transition load-dependent. Separately, the scalar readout J=min(A,B) aliases worlds(0,1),(1,0); with equal priors and only one full-unit action A or B, every policy using J alone succeeds with probability at most1/2.

requires: Uniform-scale alias: prescribed shared displacement and scaling of every spring including reference and probe.
Hardening example: specified symmetric geometry, h>=0, Delta>0 and positive neutral dstar; no universal nonlinear threshold is asserted.
Action bound: exactly the two stated worlds with equal priors, identical pre-action scalar observation, two full-unit actions and a one-unit budget.

No free extra probe, diagnostic side channel or partial-action strategy is included in the two-action toy.
costs: Acquire stable/calibrated references and service deformation; pay additional sensing or material when incomplete states require different interventions.
contract.units: lambda is dimensionless; h has force/length-cubed units. A,B,J and the action budget are normalized toy units, not calibrated biological concentrations.
contract.obstruction: Supply observations that distinguish the actual deficient load path and independently establish required absolute service performance.

body: Uniform scaling multiplies both sides of the prescribed-displacement equilibrium by lambda, leaving displacements unchanged; forces and equivalent stiffness scale. Include the sensing spring in that scaling. This exact full-gap alias is not asserted under fixed force, where extension changes. At the hardening example zero gap, both midpoints equal Delta/2 and the probe carries no force. Balance Delta/2=d*Delta/2+h*(Delta/2)^3 to obtain the neutral threshold. Unknown strain can therefore mimic repair; a calibrated deformation regime or richer model is required. Equal small-strain stiffness also does not specify rupture/fatigue behavior. In the two-world action toy, J=0 in both worlds. Any observation-only randomized policy chooses A with the same probability p in both; success is[p+(1-p)]/2. The bound assumes only those two full-unit actions and no additional informative probe/intervention. Extra resources permitting both actions or additional distinguishing observations change the problem. These are scoped failures of the specific observation interface, not universal impossibility of sensing or biological repair.

Entire 486-line scientific response and 393-line original code read statically. Acceptance is for these exact conditional analytic constructions and limits. No scientific code, 10000-case randomized audit, population simulation, diffusion numerical suite or new primary-paper audit was executed. Calibrated numerical thresholds and biological/device/advantage claims are not accepted by this written-model audit.
